messages:
marta: Planning a staggered regional runtime update: EU first (2026-04-02 22:00 UTC), APAC next (2026-04-03 02:00 UTC). Scope: kernel microfix + model pin to redwood-v2-latest-safe. Goal: avoid cross-region blast radius and keep private customers unaffected unless opted-in.

deploybot: Deploy job queued: runtime-staggered-eu-apac-2026-04. EU canary: 4 nodes (~5%); APAC will use separate job after EU clears. Rollout plan: canary -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Auto-rollback: 3m sustained 5xx >0.6% OR p99 >= baseline*1.6.

sam: Draft statuspage lines? Need two localized windows. I'll schedule EU now.

leah: EU blurb suggestion: "Planned maintenance (EU): brief runtime update and model pin on 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC. Most traffic unaffected; a small number of requests may see short retries during canary. See live updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2871234567"

emily: APAC blurb: "Planned maintenance (APAC): rolling update on 2026-04-03 02:00 UTC. Customers in APAC may see transient retries during canary. Live updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2871234568"

ops_sre: Preflight checklist (EU): 1) health checks on canary 2) run long-prompt smoke set 3) snapshot KV caches 4) ensure fallback model exists. Rollback triggers: 5xx >0.6% sustained 3m OR p99 +60% for 3m OR evidence of output corruption.

nate: Add private/dedicated note: "Dedicated/private pools will not be changed unless the rollout specifically targets them. Account teams will be notified if we plan to touch reserved pools."

sam: Support email snippet (global):

sam: Subject: Planned runtime maintenance  EU & APAC windows

sam: Body: "We will perform brief, regional runtime updates on Apr 02 (EU) and Apr 03 (APAC). Most customers will be unaffected; some may see short retries during canary. If you have dedicated or private pools, you will only be affected if your account team confirmed scheduling. Live updates: https://status.redwood.ai/"

marta: Internal rollback playbook (short):

marta: "If triggered: 1) pause rollout to 0% 2) re-pin traffic to redwood-v2-latest-stable 3) notify customers via status + support DM list 4) open incident channel if >10% traffic impacted"

support-bot: Scheduled reminder: post EU status at 2026-04-02T21:40:00Z (20m prior).

leah: Thumbs up if ready to schedule EU publish. @marta @ops_sre @nate

ops_sre: :thumbsup:

marta: :thumbsup:

nate: :thumbsup:

sam: I'll queue two statusposts and a customer email to low-priority list for EU (send 21:45 UTC).

deploybot: EU canary started. Canary pulse (5m): 5xx 0.04%, p99 +9%. No rollback, will move to 20% in 8m.

ops_sre: Noting a GC bump on one canary host, excluding it. No customer-visible errors.

leah: Excluding host acknowledged. Keep APAC job cold until EU fully green.

marta: 20% complete. Holding 10m to watch p99.

deploybot: 50% complete after hold. Metrics stable: 5xx 0.07%, p99 +11%.

emily: EU statuspage published and email sent to low-priority recipients.

marta: Proceeding to 100% for EU. After EU resolves, we'll trigger APAC job with same checklist.

deploybot: EU rollout finished at 23:18 UTC. No rollback. Scheduling APAC job for 02:00 UTC as planned.

support-bot: EU incident resolved: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2871234567  resolved at 2026-04-02T23:20:00Z

marta: Keeping this thread open for APAC kickoff updates.
